title: Renewal Staging Runbook & Pipeline Tracker — Sept 2026
overview: Working tracker used by CS Ops to stage renewals for Q4. Combines risk signals, tailored playbook actions, defined next touch dates and escalation triggers. This is a living doc used during weekly renewal scrubs and handoffs to AEs.

actions: Weekly renewal scrub cadence: Mon 10am PT — update next_touch and owner before meeting
Trigger playbook when churn signals include usage_down >15% or open_billing_dispute
For accounts >$250k ARR and probability <70%, initiate exec-level outreach within 7 days
Document all legal blockers in linked JIRA ticket and change status to 'Legal Block' in main tracker
If no response after two scheduled touches, route to Growth for winback or churn analysis
notes: Scratchpad: test a 'fast-fail' playbook for sub-50% probability accounts under $50k ARR — small experiment in Q4. Add column for 'last_escalation_date' next revision.
